title: GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.02091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervision. Yet the geometry representation can still collapse toward one dominant direction, and unrestricted attention can leave the latents underused during answer learning. We introduce GeoLatent, combining Common--Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure the geometry states while promoting latent-mediated answer learning. translated_title: GeoLatent：基于路由优化的几何引导潜在结构化用于3D推理
translated_abstract: 尽管视觉-语言模型取得了进展，但从2D图像进行3D空间推理仍然具有挑战性。基于文本的方法使用离散token描述中间几何，限制了连续空间关系的保真度。连续潜在表示提供了更丰富的表示，但单一的潜在类型无法显式分离不同空间任务所需的线索。分解的空间潜在变量通过在几何监督下分别表示位置、方向和全局几何来解决这一问题。然而，几何表示仍然可能向某一个主导方向坍缩，且不受限制的注意力机制可能导致潜在变量在答案学习过程中利用不足。我们提出了GeoLatent，将“共同-残差几何对齐”（CR-GEO）与路由优化相结合，在结构化几何状态的同时促进以潜在变量为中介的答案学习。CR-GEO将共享教师几何与残差教师几何分离；路由优化联合训练几何……
tldr: 提出GeoLatent框架，通过共同-残差几何对齐（CR-GEO）与路由优化对几何潜在状态进行结构化，防止几何表示坍缩并提升潜在变量的利用效率，从而增强从2D图像进行3D空间推理的能力。
en_tdlr: GeoLatent combines Common-Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure geometry latents, preventing representation collapse and promoting latent-mediated answer learning for improved 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images.
